strategy.offer: Integrated airport operations solutions and services spanning airfield, gate and tower, including guidance, control, automation, planning, installation, maintenance, training and spare parts.
strategy.customers: Airports, airport operators, airlines and air traffic control stakeholders seeking safer, more efficient, predictable and sustainable aircraft movements and ground operations.
strategy.why_we_win: It expects integrated, consultative, data-driven solutions to break operational silos, remove bottlenecks, raise throughput and safety, and reduce costs using existing infrastructure.
strategy.resources: Its basis is long airport-operational experience, system-integration know-how, broad technology and service coverage, global support teams, and coordinated R&D, engineering and project capabilities.
strategy.direction: It is moving toward fully integrated, intelligent airport operations with greater automation, real-time information sharing, collaborative decision-making, sustainability and capacity growth.
